Relocation lead (unverified): No relocation lead found. DNU's own English pages place the International Students Office at 72 Nauky Avenue, Dnipro, office 117 (search summary of https://www.dnu.dp.ua/en/International_Students_Office); DNU news for 2024 (ennews/138) and 2025–2026 programme/accreditation PDFs (227 project programme for 2026–2027, 2026 NAQA decision document on PhD 224) indicate ongoing activity in Dnipro. Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: No medicine (222), dentistry (221) or pharmacy (226) degree surfaced — only nursing (223), medical-diagnostics technologies (224) and physical therapy (227); the inventory group H classification stands. Absence in search results is not proof of absence.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Foreign-applicant route is generic: the 'Admission of Foreigners' page (https://www.dnu.dp.ua/en/admission_of_foreigners) describes a preparatory faculty, language courses, postgraduate/internship programmes and enrolment via the Unified Interdepartmental Information System, but no lead ties foreign admission or English-medium teaching to the 223/224/227 programmes.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Accreditation status unverified: the 2020 master's 223 document stated 'До проходження первинної акредитації'; 2025–2026 NAQA-related PDFs for 227 and PhD 224 are self-hosted and their outcomes were not shown.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Name confusion: distinct from the listed Dnipro State Medical University (slug dnipro-state-medical-university) and from Ukrainian State University of Science and Technologies (also Dnipro, inventory group H); 'Dnipro National University' / 'DNU' must not be mapped to either.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Conflicting international-enrolment figures across sources (Wikipedia ~130; DNU fact sheet 166; THE and FAO AGRIS ~3,000 — apparently pre-2014 figures): aggregator data is stale.
